proposals.relationship: Mazower argues that Hobsbawm’s communist loyalties constrained his twentieth-century history while distinguishing this from the value of his Marxist analysis.
proposals.evidence_note: Own2020review paragraphs beginning Party membership had affected his work and Unlike his communism. Mazower reports Hobsbawm’s admission to Antonio Polito about avoiding comrades’ sensitivities and calls Age of Extremes a lesser work because it entered that uncomfortable terrain. Praise for Marxism’s crisis analysis, totality and readable synthesis is retained. This is a limited judgment by Mazower, not a claim that every Hobsbawm work is invalid or that the biographies/Polito original were independently read.
